text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp still seeing token-related spikes. After we added client-side windowing the app occasionally blasts a bunch of concurrent requests during a refresh and we hit soft 429s from the API. Not constant but reproducible in the lab.

aj: Any logs or a quick repro?

maria: Minimal log snippet:
```
INFO request id=abc1 cursor=cur_42 inflight=8 status=401
INFO token refresh start
INFO token refresh done
INFO retrying request id=abc1 cursor=cur_42 inflight=9 -> duplicate send
INFO upstream 429 backlog=120
```
Notice inflight increments after refresh -> we end up with overshoot. Looks like requests that were waiting for auth get retried without returning their permit to the window.

kevin: Huh. JS SDK parity note: py-sdk uses an "acquire -> send -> release on any terminal state (error|success)" pattern. If JS does "send and only release on success" then auth-retries will cause duplicates because the retry path re-acquires but the original permit wasn't released.

maria: Exactly. In our sampleapp the windowing lives in the client lib, and the auth wrapper does an internal retry which re-enqueues the original promise. If the inflight counter wasn't decremented on the retry path we double-count. Repro steps: 1) set windowSize=8, 2) force token expiry mid-batch, 3) fire 100-page pagination requests.

sam: Quick mitigation: make auth middleware do a transient release before starting refresh, i.e. `releasePermit()` then `refresh()` then `acquirePermit()` to re-send. Alternatively change window logic to use lease tokens (idempotent lease per logical request) so retry doesn't consume extra slot.

kevin: Leaning toward the lease approach for correctness. Implementation sketch:
```js
// pseudo
const lease = await window.acquire(); // returns an id
try {
  await sendWithAuth(lease, req);
} finally {
  window.release(lease);
}
// sendWithAuth handles refresh but keeps same lease id when retrying
```
This keeps accounting stable even if sendWithAuth replays.

aj: Can someone put a small failing unit test in the sampleapp that simulates a mid-batch token expiry? I can cut a patch for the JS SDK once we have a deterministic repro.

maria: I'll add a flaky-429 integration test to the sampleapp repo today and link a trace.

devex-bot: Created ticket #RDW-3219: "sampleapp: client window overshoot on auth-retry" and linked branch r/patch/window-lease.

aj: Cool. Assign to @kevin for design and @maria for repro. I'll take the SDK patch after the test lands. :thumbsup:

sam: If we go lease-route, let's also document behavior in the onboarding guide so users know why inflight counters are stable during refresh. Small docs blurb + example code should help reduce support noise.

maria: Agreed. I'll draft a 3-line note in the quickstart and drop the sample test link once done.
